title: Fund n Forget
tagline: FundNForget is a Web3 DeFi app for effortless crypto investing with professional fund managers. Users connect wallets, choose investment amounts, and automation handles the rest. Fund managers publish strategies, and the app automatically implements them.
description:
FundNForget is a pioneering Web3 DeFi (Decentralized Finance) application that revolutionizes the way individuals invest in cryptocurrency funds managed by professional fund managers. Our platform bridges the gap between seasoned crypto experts and everyday users, making sophisticated investment strategies accessible to everyone.

For users, the process is seamless and intuitive:

Connect Wallet: Users simply connect their existing crypto wallets to our secure platform.

Choose Funds: Browse through a curated list of funds managed by experienced professionals, each with detailed performance metrics and strategy overviews.

Invest Effortlessly: Decide how much to invest in the selected funds. Once invested, all fund management activities are automated.

Automated Management: Our smart contracts handle all aspects of fund management, including asset allocation, rebalancing, and performance tracking.

Transparency and Control: Users can monitor their investments in real-time, with the freedom to adjust or withdraw at any time.

For fund managers, FundNForget offers a powerful and user-friendly dashboard:

Publish Strategies: Fund managers can easily create and share their investment strategies with potential investors.

Automated Implementation: The platform automates the execution of strategies, allowing managers to focus on optimizing performance rather than technical execution.

Analytics and Insights: Access to advanced analytics helps managers refine their strategies and demonstrate value to investors.

Expand Reach: By leveraging our platform, fund managers can tap into a broader audience without the need for extensive marketing or technical infrastructure.
Innovation and Impact:

Democratizing Access: FundNForget lowers the barriers to entry for crypto investments, allowing anyone to benefit from professional fund management without requiring deep technical knowledge.

Secure and Transparent: Built on blockchain technology, all transactions and fund performances are immutable and transparent, fostering trust between users and fund managers.

Scalable and Efficient: The use of smart contracts automates complex processes, reducing overhead and increasing efficiency for both investors and fund managers.

Empowering the DeFi Ecosystem: By simplifying crypto asset management, we contribute to the growth and maturation of the DeFi space.

Why FundNForget Stands Out:

User-Centric Design: A focus on simplicity ensures that even those new to crypto can confidently invest.

Professional Expertise: Users gain access to top-tier fund managers, benefiting from their expertise and track records.

Automation at Its Best: The "set it and forget it" approach means users can invest without the need for constant monitoring.

Community and Support: An active community and dedicated support ensure users and fund managers have the resources they need to succeed.

FundNForget is not just an app—it's a movement towards making crypto investments smarter, more accessible, and more efficient. We're transforming the DeFi landscape by empowering users to grow their wealth effortlessly while enabling fund managers to reach new heights in their professional endeavors.
how_its_made:
We have three main components: on chain smart contracts written in solidity and deployed on the base sepolia chain, off chain Node.JS app that reduces the load on the EVM and provides privacy and a react based frontend that will act as the interface for the users.

Privy: Privy is used in the front end to onboard the users and also to maintain the authentication state all through the app. Signers from the privy context are used to authenticate all the transactions and smart contract calls.

Blockscout: Block scout explorer link to the investors wallet is provided on their screen so that the users can examine their transactions and also track their balances.

Sign Protocol: The strategies that the fund managers use is stored in an encrypted manner using sign protocol's schemas. Lit protocol is used to encrypt the data related to these strategies. The users who have invested in a particular fund access these strategies directly using the sign protocol.

Lit Protocol: The actual encryption of the data in the sign protocol schemas is handled using the lit protocol so as to perform this process in a trustless distriuted manner. So decoding this data will again require the usage of Lit protocol from the backend.

Pyth Price Feeds: Pyth price feeds are used to value the initial investments of users in USDT. This helps them track their PnL in a daily manner. This is also used to value the portfolio so that the swaps can be performed.

Uniswap v4 : Uniswap is used to swap the currencies to maintain the assets according to the fund's chosen strategy. b4 beforeSwap hook is used for enforcing platform fee.

Pyth entropy: Pyth entropy module is used to generate random numbers so that investors who are confused about what fund to invest in can randomize their investments.
